title: Keyboard manager: remapping numpad digits inserts wrong digits in browsers

status.label: Confirm Persian numeral remapping in current browsers
status.detail: The reporter says numpad remaps to Persian numerals work in Notepad but produce other digits in browsers; the latest screenshot and affected-app details date from 2024.

judgment.rationale: The report lists PowerToys 0.81.0 and remaps numpad digits to Persian numerals. The reporter says Notepad works, but Chrome/Firefox produce different Persian digits; a later comment says a browser requires Ctrl for the remapped output. The reporter supplied a screenshot of the mapping and asked for an update in November 2024, but no current-version report or maintainer response is present.
evidence: The original report lists PowerToys 0.81.0 and says the numpad mappings work in Notepad but produce other digits in browsers.
The reporter later supplied a screenshot and a specific example where numpad 5 can emit a sequence of different Persian digits.
A commenter reports a browser-only remap issue and says Ctrl is needed for the expected output; the original reporter has not confirmed whether this is the same setup.
The reporter asked for an update in November 2024; no later reply or linked fix was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the exact Persian-numeral mapping still fails on current stable and which browser/version and NumLock state are involved; do not request the screenshot again.

fix_assessment.rationale: If current builds still emit different digits only in browsers, Keyboard Manager may be sending a key identity or layout-dependent event that browser input handling translates differently from Notepad. Current reproduction conditions need confirmation.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve Persian numpad digit mappings in browsers
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The injected key event for a Persian numeral may be interpreted differently by browser input controls than by Notepad, potentially because of NumLock state, keyboard layout, or a browser-specific input path.
plan: Confirm current PowerToys, browser, keyboard layout, and NumLock state using the existing mapping screenshot.
Compare a single numpad remap in Notepad and one affected browser with and without Ctrl held.
Trace the emitted key identity and layout translation for the first incorrect digit.
If Keyboard Manager emits the wrong event, correct the mapping path and add a browser/layout regression test.
verification: Verify each numpad key produces its configured Persian numeral in Notepad and the affected browser.
Verify the mapping does not require an undocumented Ctrl modifier.
Verify NumLock and ordinary numpad digits continue to work.

confidence.rationale: The app-dependent output and mapping screenshot are available, but current versions, NumLock state, and the reporter's confirmation of the Ctrl behavior are missing.

issue_context.summary: Numpad-to-Persian-numeral remaps reportedly produce incorrect digits in browsers while working in Notepad.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.81.0 and remaps numpad digits to Persian numerals.
The reporter says Notepad works but browsers can produce other digits.
A screenshot of the remapping is already attached.
A commenter reports a similar browser-only symptom and says Ctrl is needed, but the original reporter has not confirmed that behavior.
inferences: Browser input handling, NumLock state, or layout translation may affect the injected key identity, but the exact factor is not established.
issue_context.analysis: The supplied screenshot and app comparison are useful; the remaining evidence should distinguish current-version behavior and layout/NumLock effects. Do not request duplicate screenshots or generic diagnostics before reproducing.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body and four comments, including the reporter's screenshot and app-specific clarification.
No linked fix or exact covering issue was found.

information_gaps.information: Whether the Persian-numeral mapping still fails on current stable, and the affected browser/version and NumLock state
information_gaps.why_needed: These details determine whether the old report persists and whether the error follows a browser input path or the keyboard's numpad state.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the current PowerToys and browser versions, active input layout, NumLock state, and whether the same number is wrong with Ctrl held.

actions.label: Confirm current Persian numeral browser behavior

Could you confirm whether the remap still produces the wrong Persian digits on current stable, and share the browser/version, active input layout, NumLock state, and whether holding Ctrl changes the result?
